reviews.text: We took our puppy in for her first groom. Anna was tremendous, patient and very attentive. Our pup has come back looking fantastic.

I have been searching for a new  groomer for my dog Teddy.  I found Pawparazzi on Social media which was local to me.
Teddy was excited when he met Anna, who might I add was lovely, warm and very welcoming . She was extremely professional and went through everything with me. When I collected Teddy, I was very happy with the wonderful and professional job Anna did.
I would highly recommend her and will definitely be going back, my search is over.😻

Really recommend Anna, she was really attentive with Milo and always gave us feedback and recommendations on how to care for Milo’s fur. She did a really good job with Milo’s first adult groom and now he looks like a handsome boy :)
10/10 highly recommend! Obie seemed so comfortable and the space is great. He came out looking so fresh, with a great cut! Will be back

We had such a lovely experience with Anna.  She was so welcoming, friendly and reassuring from the moment we arrived. She talked us through everything and took the time to make sure my dog felt comfortable and at ease, which really meant a lot.

She was absolutely lovely and did a fantastic job. You can tell she genuinely cares about the dogs in her care, and we couldn’t be happier with the whole experience.

I would 100% recommend her to anyone looking for a kind, caring and professional groomer. We will definitely be returning! 🐶❤️

Our dog has always been super shy and usually dreads going to the groomer, but Anna at Pawparazzi completely turned that around. Now, he actually gets excited to go and loves being pampered by her!

Anna is genuinely a wonderful human being and so knowledgeable. She always takes the time to give thoughtful, kind feedback and practical suggestions on how to keep our four legged friend looking and feeling his best between visits. You can tell she truly cares about the dogs she works with. I can't recommend her and Pawparazzi enough! 👏👏👏

First time I've taken my Dog Tuppence to this groomer , she was amazing with him , really lovely person and I felt very comfortable leaving him
He looked absolutely gorgeous,  did everything I asked , would highly recommend

Had their first appointment today. They came out calm and seemed very happy there. They both smelt absolutely amazing. The place its self is so clean and beautifully decorated and a calm environment for the dogs. This will now be my dog groomers and definitely recommend at a reasonable price too.
Thank you

This was my first time using Pawparazzi Star Lane and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. The service was excellent from start to finish and everything exceeded my expectations.
My dog is usually quite lively and doesn’t always stay still but today he behaved impeccably thanks to Anna. She treated him with such patience, care and genuine affection and the grooming was absolutely exceptional. It’s clear that she truly loves what she does and it shows in the wonderful results.
We’ve definitely decided to keep Anna as our regular groomer and I would happily recommend Pawparazzi Star Lane to anyone looking for a professional, caring and trustworthy grooming service for their dog. Thank you for such a fantastic experience!❤️

I can’t recommend this groomer enough! They took such amazing care of my dog from start to finish. They were so patient, kind, and clearly love what they do. My dog came back looking absolutely beautiful, smelling amazing, and they seemed so happy and relaxed.

The attention to detail was incredible, and you can tell they genuinely care about the comfort and wellbeing of every dog they groom. It’s such a relief knowing I can leave my dog with someone I completely trust. Thank you for doing such a fantastic job – we’ll definitely be back and I’ll be recommending to everyone!
